intro: CAVA Tzatziki is a refreshing Greek yogurt-based dip that brings cool, tangy flavors to your Mediterranean bowl or pita. At just 30 calories, this classic spread combines creamy yogurt with fresh cucumber, garlic, and dill. Available as part of the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads), Tzatziki adds authentic Mediterranean taste without weighing down your meal.
priceCalories: Tzatziki is included with your order at no extra charge when you select up to 3 dips and spreads. At only 30 calories per serving, it is one of the lightest options on the [full CAVA menu](/). With 2g protein, 1g carbs, and 2.5g fat, this dip provides balanced nutrition while keeping your meal fresh and flavorful.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets CAVA Tzatziki apart is its authentic Greek preparation using real Greek yogurt, fresh cucumber, and aromatic dill. The combination of garlic and lemon creates a bright, zesty flavor that complements Mediterranean ingredients perfectly. Unlike heavy sauces, Tzatziki adds moisture and tang without overwhelming other flavors in your bowl or pita from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls).
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Tzatziki contains 30 calories, making it an excellent low-calorie choice. The macronutrient breakdown includes 2g of protein from Greek yogurt, just 1g of carbohydrates, and 2.5g of fat. This balanced profile makes Tzatziki suitable for various dietary preferences. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to track your complete meal nutrition.
whatsInside: CAVA Tzatziki features five simple, wholesome ingredients: Greek yogurt as the creamy base, fresh cucumber for crunch and hydration, garlic for savory depth, dill for herbal notes, and lemon for brightness. This clean ingredient list contains no artificial additives or preservatives. The Greek yogurt provides probiotics and protein while keeping calories low.
tasteLike: Tzatziki delivers a cool, creamy texture with refreshing cucumber notes and tangy yogurt flavor. The garlic adds subtle warmth while dill provides herbal complexity. A hint of lemon brightens the overall taste, creating a perfectly balanced dip that cools spicy ingredients. The consistency is smooth yet light, coating ingredients without being heavy or rich.
customize: Customize your meal by pairing Tzatziki with spicy proteins from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) like Spicy Lamb Meatballs or Harissa Chicken for cooling contrast. Combine it with other dips like Hummus or Roasted Eggplant Dip to create flavor variety. Add Tzatziki to grain bases or use it as a lighter alternative to creamy dressings for a Mediterranean-style meal.
pairsWell: Tzatziki pairs exceptionally well with grilled proteins, especially chicken, lamb, and falafel. It complements warm grains from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) like Brown Rice or RightRice. The cooling effect balances spicy toppings such as Feta, pickled onions, or hot harissa. Try it alongside Red Pepper Hummus or Harissa for a diverse flavor experience.
healthyChoice: At only 30 calories with 2g of protein, Tzatziki is an excellent healthy choice for calorie-conscious diners. The Greek yogurt base provides probiotics that support digestive health. With minimal carbs and moderate healthy fats, it fits into low-carb, keto, and Mediterranean diet patterns. The fresh ingredients deliver nutrients without added sugars or unhealthy fats.
howToOrder: Order Tzatziki when building your custom bowl or pita at CAVA. Select up to 3 dips and spreads at no additional charge during the customization process. Tzatziki works on any base and complements most protein choices. For a complete Mediterranean experience, explore the [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) where Tzatziki often appears as a featured ingredient.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Hummus at 50 calories, Tzatziki offers 40% fewer calories while providing similar protein content. Unlike Harissa at 70 calories with bold spice, Tzatziki delivers cooling refreshment at less than half the calories. Red Pepper Hummus and Roasted Eggplant Dip both contain more calories than Tzatziki, making it the lightest spread option for those watching caloric intake.
whoShouldTry: Tzatziki is perfect for anyone seeking authentic Mediterranean flavors with minimal calories. Low-carb and keto dieters appreciate its macronutrient profile. Those who enjoy cooling, tangy flavors or need balance against spicy ingredients will love this dip. If you prefer lighter alternatives to heavy dressings or creamy sauces, Tzatziki provides ideal moisture and flavor enhancement.
worthTrying: Absolutely worth trying, especially considering it is included at no extra charge. Tzatziki adds authentic Mediterranean character to any meal while keeping nutrition in check. Its versatility makes it valuable whether you are building a light salad or hearty grain bowl. The fresh, clean flavors elevate your CAVA experience without adding significant calories or cost.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Tzatziki?
faqs.a: CAVA Tzatziki contains 30 calories per serving, making it one of the lowest-calorie dips available on the menu. It provides 2g protein, 1g carbs, and 2.5g fat in each serving.

faqs.q: Is CAVA Tzatziki included or does it cost extra?
faqs.a: Tzatziki is included at no additional charge when you select up to 3 dips and spreads with your bowl or pita. It is part of the standard customization options at CAVA.

faqs.q: What ingredients are in CAVA Tzatziki?
faqs.a: CAVA Tzatziki is made with Greek yogurt, fresh cucumber, garlic, dill, and lemon. These simple, natural ingredients create an authentic Mediterranean flavor without artificial additives or preservatives.

faqs.q: Is Tzatziki gluten-free and vegetarian at CAVA?
faqs.a: Yes, CAVA Tzatziki is both gluten-free and vegetarian. It contains dairy from Greek yogurt but no gluten-containing ingredients. For complete allergen details, visit the CAVA Allergen Menu for comprehensive dietary information.

faqs.q: What does CAVA Tzatziki taste like?
faqs.a: CAVA Tzatziki has a cool, creamy, and tangy flavor profile with refreshing cucumber notes, subtle garlic warmth, herbal dill essence, and bright lemon acidity. The texture is smooth and light, perfect for balancing spicy or rich ingredients.
